mechanisms.rationale: createStore defaultSchema opt + write() creation-branch application + resolveDefaultSchema validator form one atomic behavior contract (apply configured default at creation when extra.schema unset). Ships and tests entirely at the store layer via createStore unit tests (matching DIR-047's staged ship): complete safety contract via the validator (throws on invalid), independent user value for any createStore embedder without touching config readers.

loadDefaultSchema() in bin + startMcpServer() defaultSchema passthrough + .quay/config.yml per-provider schema key + sample-workspace/help docs together deliver the user-facing config key end-to-end at both CLI and MCP entry points; these call-site variants serve one atomic contract and cannot ship independently — they require m1 to receive the forwarded value.
